title: Google Pays Apple $20 Billion for One Setting

scenes.narration: Google pays Apple around 20 billion dollars a year. For one setting.
Records from the U.S. antitrust trial showed Google paid Apple 20 billion dollars in 2022, to be the default search engine in Safari.
That's the search bar you use without thinking on every iPhone, iPad and Mac.
Across all its partners, Google spent 26.3 billion dollars on default deals like this in 2021.
Why pay so much? Because most people never change the default, and every search is a chance to show ads. Follow for more.
